text:
Type: woven bamboo pendant lamp
Use: ambient light over a dining table or a sitting area; dining room, living room, bedroom
Style: Japandi, bohemian, Scandinavian
Materials: hand-woven bamboo shade in layered tiers, dark grey cord and ceiling cup
Colors: light natural bamboo, dark grey
Shape: three stacked cylinders of open lattice weave with a wider middle tier, casts patterned light, hangs on a long cord, large but light and airy
Feel: warm, natural, relaxed, calm
Goes with: light wood, linen, rattan, green plants, white walls; Japandi, bohemian or Scandinavian rooms
